title: Enhance embed URL handling and validation system

comments.text:
logic: Adding `force: true` makes this migration destructive - it will drop and recreate the table if it exists, potentially causing data loss in production

```suggestion
    create_table :top_topics do |t|
```

syntax: Unusual `end if` syntax - should be just `end`

```suggestion
  <%- end %>
```

logic: Using `open()` is deprecated and creates security vulnerabilities (command injection, SSRF). Use `Net::HTTP`, `HTTParty`, or similar safe HTTP libraries instead.

```suggestion
    doc = Readability::Document.new(Net::HTTP.get_response(URI(url)).body,
```
logic: Incorrect require_dependency path - should be 'jobs/scheduled/poll_feed' not 'jobs/regular/process_post'
logic: URL validation is insufficient - allows access to internal services (localhost, 192.168.x.x, etc). Add proper SSRF protection.

style: URI parsing can raise exceptions for malformed URLs. Wrap in begin/rescue block.

```suggestion
    begin
      uri = URI(url)
    rescue URI::InvalidURIError
      return contents
    end
```
logic: Potential XSS vulnerability - URL should be HTML-escaped before embedding in HTML content.

style: Consider using `expect(response).not_to be_successful` instead of the deprecated `should_not be_success` syntax

```suggestion
    expect(response).not_to be_successful
```
style: Mock object setup could be more explicit by using `double` instead of `mock` for better RSpec compatibility
style: Redis key includes raw URL which could contain special characters - consider URL encoding or hashing the key

logic: Security concern: Using `request.referer` as postMessage target origin could be vulnerable to header spoofing. Consider using a whitelist of allowed origins or the embeddable_host setting instead.

logic: No error handling if SiteSetting.embed_by_username is nil or empty string

```suggestion
      user = User.where(username_lower: SiteSetting.embed_by_username&.downcase).first
```

style: Consider checking `parent !== window` instead of just `if (parent)` to avoid sending messages when not in an iframe context.

```suggestion
          if (parent !== window) {
```
logic: Using `force: true` will drop the table if it exists, potentially causing data loss in production. Consider removing this option or using conditional table creation.
style: Missing foreign key constraints for `topic_id` and `post_id`. Consider adding `add_foreign_key` statements to enforce referential integrity.

style: Use `expect().to be_nil` instead of deprecated `should be_nil` syntax

```suggestion
      expect(TopicEmbed.import(user, "invalid url", title, contents)).to be_nil
```

style: Use `expect().to eq(0)` instead of deprecated `should ==` syntax

```suggestion
      expect(TopicEmbed.count).to eq(0)
```

style: Use `expect().to eq()` instead of deprecated `should ==` syntax

```suggestion
        expect(post.cook_method).to eq(Post.cook_methods[:raw_html])
```
style: Use `expect().to be_truthy` instead of deprecated `should be_true` syntax ```suggestion expect(post.cooked.start_with?("hello world new post hello ")).to be_truthy ```

style: Use `expect().to match()` instead of deprecated `should =~` syntax

```suggestion
        expect(post.cooked).to match(/new contents/)
```
style: Test reuses `post` variable name which shadows the let! variable from line 24, potentially causing confusion
logic: Critical XSS vulnerability - `discourseUrl` is not validated and could contain malicious JavaScript. Use proper URL validation and sanitization
logic: Host validation can be bypassed if `request.referer` is nil - the `|| ''` fallback makes `URI('').host` return nil, which could equal `SiteSetting.embeddable_host` if it's also nil
logic: Setting X-Frame-Options to 'ALLOWALL' permits embedding from any domain, potentially enabling clickjacking attacks from malicious sites

logic: Security vulnerability: using `open` without URL validation allows potential SSRF attacks and local file access

```suggestion
      require 'net/http'
      require 'uri'
      
      uri = URI.parse(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid URL scheme" unless %w[http https].include?(uri.scheme)
      
      response = Net::HTTP.get_response(uri)
      raise "HTTP error: #{response.code}" unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
      
      rss = SimpleRSS.parse response.body
```
style: use `find_by(id: args[:user_id])` instead of `where().first` for cleaner code
